# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source("https://inkaverse.com/setup.r")

gs4_deauth()

font <- c("Merriweather Sans", "Permanent Marker", "Tillana")
huito_fonts(font)
```

# Field-book

```{r}
#| label: fieldbook

url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fQTVUyZIlGckLvdp1hmT8kg66MvLvNr96nI4fkdBta0/edit?usp=sharing"

fb <- url %>%
  as_sheets_id() %>%
  range_read(sheet = "fb") %>%
  mutate(across(c(plots, ntreat, dosis_ml, block), as.character)
         , dosis = paste(dosis_ml, "mL")                     # ej. "10 mL"
         )

fb %>% dplyr::select(qrcode, plots, ntreat, dosis, block)
```

# Labels

```{r}
#| label: labels

label <- fb %>%
  label_layout(size = c(5.2, 10)
               , border_color = "forestgreen"
               , border_width = 1.5
               ) %>%
  include_image(
    value = "https://doctoradofisica.uni.edu.pe/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/d123d3.webp"
    , size = c(3.0, 0.9)
    , position = c(1.75, 9.3)
    ) %>%
  include_text(value = "plots"
               , position = c(4.25, 9.3)
               , size = 15
               , color = "black"
               , font = font[3]
               ) %>%
  include_image(
    value = "https://huito.inkaverse.com/img/scale.pdf"
    , size = c(4.8, 0.77)
    , position = c(2.6, 8.35)
    ) %>%
  include_barcode(
    value = "qrcode"
    , size = c(4.6, 4.6)
    , position = c(2.6, 5.5)
    ) %>%
  include_text(value = "dosis"
               , position = c(2.6, 2.6)
               , size = 14
               , color = "blue"
               , font = font[1]
               , prefix = "Dosis: "
               ) %>%
  include_text(value = "ntreat"
               , position = c(1.5, 1.8)
               , size = 12
               , color = "red"
               , font = font[1]
               , prefix = "Trat: "
               ) %>%
  include_text(value = "block"
               , position = c(3.7, 1.8)
               , size = 12
               , color = "darkgreen"
               , font = font[1]
               , prefix = "Bloque: "
               ) %>%
  include_image(
    value = "https://huito.inkaverse.com/img/scale.pdf"
    , size = c(4.8, 0.77)
    , position = c(2.6, 0.85)
    , opts = 'image_convert(type = "Grayscale")'
    )

label %>% label_print(mode = "preview")
```

# Labels to print

```{r}
#| label: print
#| eval: false

dir.create("files", showWarnings = FALSE)

label %>%
  label_print(mode = "complete"
              , filename = "files/labels_coliflor"
              , units = "cm"
              )
```
